items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then I subbed over there when Jack Parr took over, with José Melis.

ctx.x: That as fun. Let’s see. Who was conducting? Milton DeLugg was his conductor. Then I subbed over there when Jack Parr took over, with José Melis. Then when Steve Allen . . . .
Was this when Clark Terry was in the band? Or did he . . . ?
